originalTitle: Politics and peek-a-boo in Australian parliament as senator brings baby to work
summary: Senator Lidia Thorpe kept 6-month-old Aaliyah entertained, as her mum Senator Fatima Payman, participated in an online safety bill debate.
content:
Australian Senator Fatima Payman brought her baby daughter, Aaliyah, to a parliamentary vote on holding social media platforms accountable for online harms.

While the lawmaker was speaking, baby Aaliyah captured the attention of Senator Lidia Thorpe and enjoyed a game of peek-a-boo.

Payman made history when she became the first hijab-wearing woman elected to Australia's Parliament in 2022, and the first sitting senator from Western Australia to give birth while in office, in 2026.

Read more about Australia's approach to social media.
chineseTitle: 参议员带着孩子上班，澳大利亚议会的政治和躲猫猫
chineseSummary: 参议员莉迪亚·索普 (Lidia Thorpe) 让 6 个月大的艾丽雅 (Aaliyah) 开心不已，而她的妈妈参议员法蒂玛·佩曼 (Fatima Payman) 则参加了在线安全法案辩论。
chineseContent:
澳大利亚参议员法蒂玛·佩曼 (Fatima Payman) 带着她的小女儿阿莉雅 (Aaliyah) 参加议会投票，要求社交媒体平台对网络伤害负责。

当议员讲话时，小艾莉雅引起了参议员莉迪亚·索普的注意，并享受了一场躲猫猫的游戏。

佩曼创造了历史，她于 2022 年成为第一位当选澳大利亚议会议员的戴头巾女性，并于 2026 年成为第一位在任期间生下孩子的西澳大利亚参议员。

详细了解澳大利亚对待社交媒体的方式。
